content.title: About
content.content: Brains is a dietary supplement designed to support cognitive function. It combines nootropic compounds, B‑vitamins, omega‑3 fatty acids, and plant extracts known for their positive effects on memory, focus, and mood.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The formula includes L‑theanine, naturally found in green tea, which promotes relaxation without drowsiness.
Omega‑3s in the form of DHA and EPA come from fish oil, essential components of neuronal membranes.
B‑vitamins (B6, B9, B12) are involved in the synthesis of neurotransmitters such as serotonin and dopamine.
Ginkgo biloba extract improves microcirculation in the brain, enhancing oxygen and glucose delivery to neurons.
The product has undergone clinical trials showing improved working memory scores in healthy adults.

items.title: Memory support
items.content: Nootropic ingredients help strengthen the formation and retention of new memories.

items.title: Enhanced focus
items.content: Balanced L‑theanine and caffeine maintain concentration without sharp energy spikes.

items.title: Reduced mental fatigue
items.content: B‑vitamins support neuronal energy metabolism, decreasing feelings of brain fatigue.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Plant extracts and vitamin E protect brain cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: The combination of DHA and vitamin D aids neurotransmitter synthesis that influences emotional well‑being.

items.title: Fish oil allergy
items.content: The supplement contains fish oil; avoid if you have a known allergy.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Caffeine and certain nootropics may amplify the effects of stimulants; consult a physician if you take heart or psychotropic medications.

items.title: Pregnancy and lactation
items.content: Safety during pregnancy and breastfeeding has not been established; seek medical advice.

items.title: Side effects
items.content: Rarely, users may experience headaches, nausea, or sleep disturbances.

content.title: How to Take
content.content: Take 2 capsules daily with a meal, accompanied by plenty of water. Do not exceed the recommended dose without professional guidance.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep the bottle tightly sealed in its original container.
